findings.scenario: After predecessor timeout, service close waits only the released poll and jobs. The owned admission can still be awaiting terminal state and later access index/wallet after main has closed them.

findings.scenario: Each terminal exemption reads its own newer escrow checkpoint while final admission only rechecks the older board anchor. An early terminal checkpoint can reorg during later predecessor reads while the old board anchor remains canonical, leaving a stale exemption accepted.
findings.repair: Pin every terminal escrow read to the captured board anchor through the existing canonical port, or revalidate all exact observation anchors before admission. Preferred bounded repair pins original canonical height/hash and retains numbered canonical checks.
